note: Positive and defeating cases for the lessons inbox proposed by .claude/drafts/history-lineage-and-lessons-brief.md. A lesson is a Proposal: it names its claim, its evidence_addresses (lineage SOURCES.lock source ids in stable reference form - commit SHA, PR number, session id - never an absolute host path), its intended landing (fixture, lint, decision, known-gap, seam, or drop), and its standing. VALID means the entry is admissible into the inbox at RECORDED standing. REFUSED means the attempted write must be refused with a refusal whose text contains the case's refuses substring, so a case cannot pass by raising some unrelated defect. A lesson enters at RECORDED and climbs only RECORDED -> ADMITTED -> RATIFIED -> EFFECTIVE; only Bdo ratifies, and LC-004 guards that entry boundary mechanically without resolving any open decision. This corpus stands at proposal standing ahead of its consumer: no inbox implementation reads it yet, and the landing vocabulary is fixed to the brief's six values as a reversible default.

cases.proves: A complete lesson - claim, evidence addresses in SOURCES.lock stable reference form, a declared landing, standing RECORDED - is admissible into the inbox.

lesson.claim: The CLAUDE.md repository snapshot drifted from the recorded history within one day of being written; orientation text decays faster than the record it summarises.

cases.proves: A lesson that cites no source is a memory, not a record; unattributed learning is refused at the inbox door.

lesson.claim: Write and Edit on this host emit CRLF unless the file is rewritten; run lint after every repository text edit.

cases.proves: A lesson that declares no landing can never drain; the inbox is a queue toward fixture, lint, decision, known-gap, seam, or drop, not a rulebook.

lesson.claim: The verify budget held at three seconds only because the oracle controls run in-process; every out-of-process addition must be measured before it lands.

cases.proves: A lesson begins RECORDED and climbs the ladder only through separate transitions; only Bdo ratifies. Writing standing RATIFIED at entry would let the author self-ratify, so the write is refused before it lands.

lesson.claim: Session transcripts hold corrections and abandoned paths that git never sees; retire them into sanitized recordings before they age out.
